Extraction

.. py:module:: graph_recc_sys.extraction

.. py:class:: DatasetManager(hyperparams: ~typing.Any | None = None) :module: graph_recc_sys.extraction

Bases: :py:class:object

Manage dataset extraction and local persistence for training data, recommendation tables, and analysis tables.

Training datasets and recommendation tables are defined consistently from the provided hyperparameters, while analysis tables are downloaded through a separate flow.

Expected directory structure:

   DATA_PATH/
   ├── training_tables/
   │   ├── dataset_<n_clients>_<min_connections>_<n_months>/
   │   │   ├── basket_data.csv
   │   │   ├── customer.csv
   │   │   ├── product.csv
   │   │   ├── product_names.csv
   │   │   └── graph_data/
   ├── rec_tables/
   │   └── <k>/
   │       ├── recommendationenginepredict_<k>.csv
   │       ├── bestseller_<k>.csv
   │       └── dataset_res_<k>_features_<add_features>.csv
   └── analysis_tables/
       └── dataset_<n_clients>_<min_connections>_<n_months>/
           ├── basket_data.csv
           ├── customer.csv
           └── product.csv

:param hyperparams: Configuration object containing dataset and recommendation settings. If provided, the manager initializes all paths needed for training and recommendation-table downloads. :type hyperparams: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:data\:\~typing.Any` | :py:obj:`None``

.. attribute:: base_data_path

  Root directory used to store all generated data. Read from the
  `DATA_PATH` environment variable, defaulting to the current directory.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: training_base_dir

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: rec_base_dir

  Base directory for recommendation tables.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: analysis_base_dir

  Base directory for analysis datasets.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: hyperparams

  Hyperparameter/configuration object passed at initialization.

  :type: Any

  Number of clients used to define the dataset.

  :type: int | None

.. attribute:: n_minimo_connessioni

  Minimum number of interactions/connections required.

  :type: int | None

.. attribute:: k

  Top-k cutoff used for recommendation tables.

  :type: int | None

.. attribute:: n_mesi

  Number of months used to filter the dataset.

  :type: int | None

.. attribute:: dataset_dir

  Directory containing the training dataset files.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: graph_dir

  Directory used to store graph-related processed artifacts.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: market_basket_path

  CSV path for user-product interactions.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: product_desc_path

  CSV path for product descriptive features.

  :type: Path

  CSV path for product names.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: customer_desc_path

  CSV path for customer descriptive features.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: rec_table_dir

  Directory containing recommendation tables for the selected `k`.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: rec_engine_path

  CSV path for the recommendation engine output.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: rec_bestseller_path

  CSV path for the bestseller baseline output.

  :type: Path

.. attribute:: rec_gnn_path

.. attribute:: analysis_product_path

  :type: Path

.. py:method:: DatasetManager.build() :module: graph_recc_sys.extraction

  Create the dataset required for model training and inference.

  This method downloads and stores, if missing:
  - market basket interactions
  - product features
  - customer features
  - product names

  :returns:     Path to the dataset directory as a string.

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`str\``

.. py:method:: DatasetManager.download_rec_table() :module: graph_recc_sys.extraction

  Download the recommendation tables for the configured top-k value.

  This method requires `hyperparams` to have been provided at construction
  time, since `k` and related paths are derived from it.

  It downloads, if missing:
  - the recommendation engine output
  - the bestseller baseline output

  :returns:     A tuple containing:
                - the recommendation engine CSV path
                - the bestseller CSV path

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`tuple\`\\ \\\[\:py\:class\:\`str\`\, \:py\:class\:\`str\`\]`

  :raises ValueError: If the manager was initialized without `hyperparams`.

.. py:method:: DatasetManager.download_analysis_table(n_clienti: int, n_connessioni_minime: int, n_mesi: int) :module: graph_recc_sys.extraction

  Download the enriched tables used for analysis.

  The tables are stored under:

      analysis_tables/<dataset_name>/

  For this call, the provided parameters temporarily overwrite the current
  dataset configuration stored in the instance.

  :param n_clienti: Number of clients to include.
  :type n_clienti: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`int\``
  :param n_connessioni_minime: Minimum number of interactions/connections required.
  :type n_connessioni_minime: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`int\``
  :param n_mesi: Number of months to include.
  :type n_mesi: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`int\``

  :returns:     Path to the analysis directory as a string.

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`str\``
